scenarios.title: Harnessing a permanent marks it so abilities that check for it apply

setup.notes: The Mind Stone is not harnessed and is untapped. Grizzly Bears is a 3/3 with one +1/+1 counter.

decisions: A activates The Mind Stone's harness ability ({5}{W}, {T}), tapping all six Plains.
Both players pass; the ability resolves and The Mind Stone becomes harnessed.
Both players pass priority through combat and second main phase to A's end step.
The Mind Stone's end-step trigger targets Grizzly Bears; both players pass.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: At the beginning of A's end step The Mind Stone's trigger fires. Grizzly Bears is exiled and returns to the battlefield as a new object, so it is a 2/2 with no counter.

variants.label: not_harnessed
variants.delta: A does not activate the harness ability.
variants.expected: At the beginning of A's end step The Mind Stone's trigger does not fire. Grizzly Bears stays on the battlefield as a 3/3 with its counter.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge implements harness as an AlterAttribute effect with Attributes$ Harnessed, and the end-step trigger has IsPresent$ Card.Self+harnessed.

scenarios.title: A permanent stays harnessed until it leaves the battlefield

setup.notes: The Mind Stone was harnessed on an earlier turn and is untapped. Grizzly Bears is a 3/3 with one +1/+1 counter.

decisions: A passes priority through combat and second main phase to A's end step without casting Into the Roil.
The Mind Stone's end-step trigger targets Grizzly Bears; both players pass.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: At the beginning of A's end step The Mind Stone, still harnessed, triggers. Grizzly Bears is exiled and returns as a 2/2 with no counter.

variants.label: bounced_and_recast
variants.delta: In main phase 1 A casts Into the Roil (tapping both Islands) on The Mind Stone, then recasts The Mind Stone (tapping both Plains).
variants.expected: The Mind Stone returns to hand and re-enters as a new object that is not harnessed. At the beginning of A's end step its trigger does not fire and Grizzly Bears stays a 3/3 with its counter.

scenarios.forge_notes: The harnessed designation of the base setup cannot be written in the card state; it is reached by a harness activation on an earlier turn.
